host_boundaries: Pen/model input arrays and IContext/canvas/resource/queue are explicit synthetic host inputs; native Model getters, ObjectDrawing route, BrushPen factory/admission, MotionEvent getter path, GLV10 geometry and RTV1 AddPoint execute in the pinned native DSOs.

The queue adapter synchronously dispatches task vslot+16; renderer/GLES callbacks and pixel rendering are outside this capture. sincosf and expf imports are serviced by Python math callbacks, so target libm math execution is not claimed.
The empty advanced setting is explicitly supplied to native ObjectStroke::SetAdvancedPenSetting; this is not an SDK-deserialized app stroke. No Samsung device or user-captured stroke is claimed.
